title: Wall Mount Robe Hook Solid Brass 2.64-Inch Projection | Antique Copper | Malibu Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Add a dedicated place to hang robes and towels with this wall mount robe hook, crafted from brass and made to coordinate with the Malibu collection in Antique Copper, which brings warm, reddish-brown tones with natural variation, perfect for rustic or craftsman-style bathrooms.

  • Antique Copper creates an inviting, organic feel
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Brass construction for a sturdy everyday hook
  • Color-coordinated mounting hardware included
  • Assembled in the USA

Specs

  • Category: Robe Hooks
  • Collection: Malibu
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Overall size: 2 in L x 2 in H x 2.64 in W
  • Projection: 2.64 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Product weight: 0.5 lb
  • Screw size: 6
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Available in multiple designer finish options to help match other versatile bath accessories in the Malibu collection.
